name: retail
title: UCI Online Retail (Chen, 2015), 1 to 7 December 2010
note: The same week as the UI sample: rows with InvoiceDate from 1 to 7 December 2010, via the app's SheetJS conversion to CSV (the full file is 23.7 MB).

prepare.sql: COPY (SELECT * FROM read_csv({src}) WHERE InvoiceDate >= TIMESTAMP '2010-12-01' AND InvoiceDate < TIMESTAMP '2010-12-08') TO {out} (HEADER)

name: wb_population

name: owid_co2
title: Our World in Data CO2 and greenhouse gas emissions, 1950 onward
note: 13 of 79 columns, years 1950 onward (the full file is 14.4 MB). OWID publishes under CC BY 4.0; the emissions columns come from the Global Carbon Project (CC BY 4.0), population and GDP from OWID's own series.

prepare.sql: COPY (SELECT country, year, iso_code, population, gdp, co2, co2_per_capita, coal_co2, oil_co2, gas_co2, cement_co2, flaring_co2, share_global_co2 FROM read_csv({src}) WHERE year >= 1950 ORDER BY country, year) TO {out} (HEADER)
